mechanism.claim: When BTC makes a large completed-hour move while its standardized execution-count response is unusually weak relative to its realized path variation and to the same elasticity across six liquid alts, the move reflects a BTC-specific participation vacuum rather than broad two-way risk transfer. Follow the completed BTC direction for eight elapsed hours at the new lower-tail crossing.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed BTC hour return
mechanism.why_distinct: CAEVC compares count-response-minus-path-variation elasticity cross-sectionally. HVLIR used BTC return divided by quote turnover; cross-asset volatility breadth counted alt volatility states; ticket candidates divided notional by trades. CAEVC uses neither notional, ticket size, taker direction, volume strata, funding, OI, nor a fitted outcome model.
mechanism.volatile_market_target: the BTC absolute completed-hour return must be in its causal top quintile; RV20 q90 remains only a later audit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: new hourly lower-tail crossings of a seven-symbol activity-elasticity residual plus an eight-hour reservation

features.hour_window: 12 exact coherent completed five-minute aggregates [D-1h,D) per symbol
features.path_variation: v_s=sqrt(sum(log(5m close/5m open)^2)) over all 12 bars, strict positive
features.execution_count: N_s=sum number_of_trades over all 60 constituent one-minute rows, strict positive integer
features.prior_zscore: for each symbol and feature independently, (current-prior mean)/prior sample standard deviation over at most 720 prior valid hours, minimum 672, current excluded, positive finite prior standard deviation required
features.tail_ranks: strict-prior midranks of Q and abs(r_BTC) over at most 2160 prior valid seven-symbol hours, minimum 1440, current excluded
features.eligible_state: Q_rank<=0.10 and abs(BTC hour return)_rank>=0.80 and BTC return strict nonzero
features.onset: current eligible state true and immediately preceding exact hourly opportunity has Q_rank>0.10; a missing prior opportunity cannot trigger
features.source_valid: all seven symbols have exact unique 1m grids, coherent finite positive OHLC, integer nonnegative number_of_trades, 12 complete 5m aggregates and positive hourly count; no imputation

rv20_stress_slice.rv20: sqrt(365*mean exact daily returns^2 over t-20 through t-1)
rv20_stress_slice.threshold: numpy linear q90 over 756 strictly prior available RV20 observations
rv20_stress_slice.future_use: only after all sequential full-calendar stages pass

clock.decision: exact UTC hour after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not an input; exact realized BTC funding only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final
post_stage_volatility_audit.persistent_long_vol_comparator: same accepted clock and 0.5 gross, side forced long
post_stage_volatility_audit.rv20_q90_decomposition: same decomposition on causal RV20 q90 decisions

definitions.btc_only_activity_vacuum: strict-prior bottom-decile crossing of A_BTC with the same BTC return-tail gate and side
definitions.cross_asset_vacuum_without_return_tail: strict-prior bottom-decile crossing of Q with nonzero BTC return, side=sign(return)
definitions.btc_return_tail_only: strict-prior top-quintile abs BTC hourly return crossing, side=sign(return)
definitions.one_hour_stale_elasticity: primary eligible boolean and side shifted by one exact hour with onset applied after the shift

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no symbol, zscore, history, rank, onset, side, clock, hold, RV20, subset, comparator, control, or gate repair
